metadata.dataset_name: Mock AfCFTA Rules-of-Origin RVC Threshold Table
metadata.provenance: SYNTHETIC. HS subheadings are real HS-2022 six-digit codes. The rvc_threshold values are plausible illustrative figures chosen for this hackathon build; they are NOT transcribed from the AfCFTA Annex 2 Appendix IV product-specific rules and must not be relied on for any real trade decision.

1806.32.description: Chocolate and other food preparations containing cocoa, in blocks, slabs or bars, not filled, weighing 2 kg or less

6109.10.description: T-shirts, singlets and other vests, knitted or crocheted, of cotton

6203.42.description: Men's or boys' trousers, bib and brace overalls, breeches and shorts, of cotton

4202.21.description: Handbags, whether or not with shoulder strap, including those without handle, with outer surface of leather, of composition leather or of patent leather

6403.99.description: Other footwear with outer soles of rubber or plastics and uppers of leather, not covering the ankle

3401.11.description: Soap and organic surface-active products in bars, cakes or moulded shapes, for toilet use, including medicated products

3923.30.description: Carboys, bottles, flasks and similar articles for the conveyance or packing of goods, of plastics
